name: mirage
text: The Odds API, audited: it is already the LAST feed on the engine's chain (after ParlayAPI, PropLine, SGO, OddsPapi, Unabated), so it is asked only when every better feed failed for a league, for a game they left out, or for a book only it carries, and each league's gap is asked at most once every 30 min. Its ~21 free keys (500 credits a month each) are paced per key by the day's share of the month. What was missing was proof of what it is spent on, so v1.0.26 adds a per-purpose tally (credits and calls by kind, for The Odds API and ParlayAPI) that the engine logs every hour. I will read the first day of numbers and cut any purpose that another API already serves; I will not guess before there is data. I changed nothing about its pacing, since it is already limited to gaps.
